title: RareEyeDesease
summary: A small research project (Jupyter notebooks) that builds classifiers for a rare eye disease dataset, addressing class imbalance by generating synthetic tabular samples. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, fit via SingleTableMetadata, to augment the minority-class training data.
